entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Vicente Villacorta Díaz was a Central American politician. From 10 July 1823 to 15 March 1824, he was a member of the triumvirates that governed the Federal Republic of Central America. From 13 December 1824 to 1 November 1826, he was head of state of El Salvador while it was a state of the Federal Republic of Central America.
